posts.name: Dalyodh Singh
posts.cooked:
Yes that is why for each code you have to practice and finally know the reason of working of each command like tee command

command | tee output.txt 2&>1

This will print command output in screen and also paste it on output.txt
2>&1 doesn’t play any significance role over here.

If you want both error and output to put in screen as well in the output.txt
Try this code instead: command 2>&1 | tee output.txt
